description.value: Haidilao Hot Pot is a location of the internationally renowned Chinese hotpot chain, housed inside The Amazing Brentwood shopping centre in Burnaby's Brentwood neighbourhood. At over 8,600 sq.ft, it is B.C.'s largest Haidilao location, offering an immersive dining experience with daily dinner-time performances and the brand's signature tableside service. Touring cyclists stopping here can expect a substantial sit-down meal with interactive, customizable hotpot dining.
